profile.headline: Principal Embedded Software Engineer
profile.summary:
I’m an experienced Software Engineer with a proven track record of leadership in software design & development, firmware, embedded systems, instrumentation, and test automation. Specifically, I have deep knowledge of Agile development practices and Git (including Git CLI) concurrent development.
Besides my technical engineering expertise, I’m a trusted cross-disciplinary leader with a successful history of:

- Leading and mentoring international development teams in large software design projects.
- Partnering with customer support engineers and customers to correct critical field issues. 
- Managing cross-functional teams in complex 3rd-party software integration. 

I hold an MS in Electrical Engineering from The University of Texas at Austin.

My technical skills include:
C/C++ | C# | Python

positions.locationName: Union City, California, United States · Hybrid

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
	Design and implement firmware for:  data acquisition board, Laser board, temperature control (PID) board (C and C++).  
	Rapid prototyping using a variety of off the shelf development boards such as: MIMXRT1060 and FRDM-KV11Z NXP boards.
	Design and implement Window based instrument control user interface (C# and Delphi)
	Experience with sensors and electric motors.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
	Design and implement software for real-time instrument control.
	Rapid prototyping using a variety of off the shelf development boards such as: Raspberry Pi, Arduino, and NXP boards.
	Designed and implemented firmware for the following devices:  Laser board, data acquisition board, and centrifuge motor control board.  Written in C and C++
	Designed and implemented Window based instrument control user interface in C#
	Experience with sensors and electric motors.

positions.title: Principal Software Consultant
positions.description:
	Designed and developed RPC infrastructure between Linux and RTOS in a multi-core ARM environment.

	Designed and implemented software to drive LEDs.  I2C communication between Raspberry PI and LED driver board.  Communicated to Raspberry from host via ethernet

positions.title: Princial. Software Engineer
positions.description:
	Designed and developed embedded VOIP applications on Linux platforms in an Agile environment.

	Developed code to bring up the DSP chips on different HW platforms. Designed and implemented software to enable DSP chip testing and debugging. 

	Integrated the 3rd-party DSP host software to work on the Calix platform. Designed and implemented the software API layer between the 3rd-party DSP host software and the control logic. 

	Designed and implemented software interface between FPGA’s and different software applications. The FPGA host software involved bringing up the FPGA with the hardware engineer. Wrote test and debug code. Wrote code to provision the FPGA to interface with the Voice DSP chip. 

	Ported existing hardware API layer to Calix new ONT platform to enable use of a common user application software on multiple hardware platforms. 

	Member of a group that designed and developed from scratch a testing platform for all Calix voice and wi-fi products.  Built both front-end (using JavaScript, JQuery, HTML, and CCS) and back-end (using Python, MySQL). 

	Acted as technical lead for offshore development sites in China and Brazil.  Mentored new engineers at these sites.

positions.title: Member of the Technical Staff
positions.description:
	Designed and wrote test software for automation. 

	Tested data quality of Service: CBR, UBR, VBR. 

	Tested Video On Demand with various VOD servers.

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer
positions.description:
	Designed and developed logging mechanism to provide uniform logging capability across the system, including in user space and kernel space. Result: enabled support of up to 100K event records per second. Logging records included audit, informational, and debug.  

	Modified and added features to real time OS kernel.  

	Designed and developed Unix Shell scripts to perform user tasks, including file transfer, file editing, and file management. 

	Designed and developed message mechanism to enable messaging between user space and kernel space tasks.

positions.title: Sr. Sw. Engineer
positions.description:
	Designed and developed firmware for BRI card. 

	Led a team of 3 engineers in the design and development of firmware for TDM-ATM card using the IMA protocol.

	Worked online unit common language code to enable its use by all line units and provided provisioning, cross-connect, hardware interface, equipment protection, and other generic features.
 
	Wrote device drivers for various receiver/transmitter chips, including BRI chip and IMA framer.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
	Designed and developed firmware for a variety of cards, including VDSL, ADSL, and BRI. 

	Worked closely with hardware development team during all stages of the project: brought up prototype boards (boot code), debugged hardware (test code), and verified hardware features. 

	Wrote device drivers for various receiver/transmitter chips, including BRI chip, xDSL chips, SLIC.
